a9.hut.text: Our second pasal. Hajurba, this one's for you.

a9.sign.text: I did the S again. It's less wobbly this time!

a9.dock.text: I tested every board. Personally. I'm a bit wet.

a9.bench.text: I could watch this water for hours.

a9.umbrella.text: Tea and sweets by the lake. Customers will love it.

a9.lights.text: Double the lights! One in the sky, one in the lake!

a9.lantern.text: It's like the lanterns are floating!

a9.bed.text: Wildflowers, just like where I grew up.

a9.arrive.text: It's so peaceful here. Just the water and the hills.
And a very, very old hut. With a very, very leaky roof.

a9.outro.text: Two shops! I can't believe it.
Your Hajurba is smiling somewhere, nani.
Next stop: the mountains! Trekkers love sweets!
Then the mountains it is. Pack warm, everyone.
